violation_type.title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(9))
violation_type.short_title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children
violation_type.typical_finding: A television was not anchored to the table it was sitting on.

finding_variants.text: A television was not anchored to the table it was sitting on.
Standing water was observed in the platform area leading to the gym classroom.
There was a mop bucket in the infant room. This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver in charge removed the mop bucket from the classroom.

While playing outside on the playground, children had access to a water table that was filled with water. Some of the children were observed splashing and playing in the water and it was confirmed by the caregiver that it had rained and the children were not supposed to be playing in the water.     This was corrected during the inspection when I asked the caregiver to pour out the water. The caregiver did remove the water and directed the children to another activity.
A television was observed to be unanchored, on top of a shelf in the toddlers' room.     Note: Television was removed during inspection.
The operation has a television that is used for the children. The television must be anchored to prevent it from tipping over.
